en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4575 - Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Bazi asked Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as) about a woman who permitted her husband to have relations with her bondwoman.
Imam (as) said: "That is permissible for him."
He then asked: "What if he fears that she might be joking?"
Imam (as) said: "If he knows that she is joking, then it is not permissible."
